notes.title: UI Fixes and New Velocity Capture Option
notes.content: A new option has been added to enhance your playing pleasures! You may now select a CC under the new Midi Velocity Capture Setting to adjust the velocity of your notes! Try it with your mouse ( I used my midi breath controller ) under this new build!
